Operational Automation with Amazon Connect Health

Amazon Web Services (AWS) has launched Amazon Connect Health, the AI agent platform it developed to optimize operational processes in healthcare institutions. Focused on reducing the administrative burden on doctors and healthcare staff, the platform makes hospitals' call center and front desk operations autonomous.

Equipped with natural language processing (NLP) capabilities, the system performs processes such as appointment scheduling, identity verification, and insurance eligibility checks 24/7 without interruption. The architecture, which works integrated with electronic health record (EHR) systems, analyzes the dialogue between doctor and patient during examination and creates real-time clinical notes. It also automatically enters the medical codes required for billing processes into the system, minimizing data entry errors.

  • Autonomous Communication: NLP-based instant response system in call center operations.
  • EHR Integration: Automatic extraction of clinical notes from medical conversations.
  • Evidence Mapping: Source matching technology for the verifiability of generated AI outputs.

The system includes a special evidence mapping mechanism to comply with healthcare sector regulations. In this way, doctors can verify the original source of the data generated by the system before approval. Along with AI solutions developed by companies such as OpenAI and Anthropic for the healthcare vertical, standards in clinical data analysis and automation are rapidly being reshaped.
